location_source.description: These are the 200 locations on the Pennsylvania Department of Health roster of medical marijuana dispensaries with product, dated September 16, 2026 and retrieved October 28, 2026. The roster lists no permit numbers or counties. County and map points come from the U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder where it matched the exact address (163 of 200). Confirm hours, products and patient requirements with the store and the Department of Health.

pathways.next_step: Search the 200 Department of Health roster locations by city, county or distance, then confirm details with the store.
pathways.limitations: Denominator: all 200 rows of the Department of Health roster dated September 16, 2026. The roster is not a live permit list and names no permit holder. Store brands are grouped by the name printed on the roster, not by ownership. 37 locations have no county or map point because the Census geocoder did not match their exact address.

pathways.next_step: Read the home-cultivation rule; hemp growers can apply for a Department of Agriculture permit.
pathways.limitations: Home cultivation of cannabis is not allowed in Pennsylvania, so no seed sellers are listed. The one route is the Department of Agriculture hemp permit for licensed hemp growing.

pathways.next_step: Check what Clean Slate seals automatically, get your record, then use a local legal-help route or the Board of Pardons.
pathways.limitations: Statewide record access, pardon and verification tools plus selected regional legal-aid, county self-help and referral routes. MidPenn, Northwestern Legal Services, Neighborhood Legal Services and Summit now have reviewed service pages describing record barriers or relief. Service areas, income limits, matter eligibility and capacity vary; county forms, legal aid, paid referrals and pardon coaching are distinct. No individual representation or automatic cannabis relief is established. Historical or unverified court leads remain in research.

pathways.next_step: Read each dated summary, then the official statute it cites.
pathways.limitations: Six state-law summaries checked October 28, 2026 against the General Assembly's statute text: medical use limits, adult-use status and small-amount possession, home cultivation, employment protection, driving and Clean Slate sealing. Not legal advice. Local ordinances, hemp-derived products, Department of Health regulations and court orders are not summarized.

pathways.next_step: Register, find an approved practitioner, then check caregiver, fee and assistance options.
pathways.limitations: Official registration, approved-practitioner, caregiver and assistance routes plus provider-stated evaluation, education, peer support and conditional subsidy resources. No individual clinician license or program approval, appointment, fee, subsidy slot or medical outcome was independently verified. Paid clinical evaluation is separate from state registration. Read the source conditions before applying.

pathways.next_step: Choose testing, legal, accounting, security, insurance, banking, payments, packaging, equipment, training or hemp resources, then confirm the engagement scope.
pathways.limitations: Selected Pennsylvania-relevant sources now include packaging, extraction equipment, software integration documentation, professional services, training and industrial-hemp resources alongside the baseline operators and laboratories. This is not a complete current permit roster or provider census. Office presence does not establish statewide service. Hemp resources are separate from medical-marijuana licensing; listing does not verify credentials, regulatory compliance or availability.

pathways.next_step: Contact a group about meetings, membership or advocacy.
pathways.limitations: Selected groups, peer networks, education programs, research resources and advocacy contacts. No Pennsylvania cannabis events are verified for the next three months. A recurring program or completed demonstration does not establish an upcoming event, open enrollment or current grant. Confirm membership, admissions and participation directly.
